data.narrative:
Defense Unicorns is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Rob Slaughter, Jeff McCoy, and Andrew Greene, currently valued at $1.0B post-money. The peer universe consists of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage.

Two valuation methods were applied to triangulate fair value. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $1.0B last post-money valuation, yielding $1.9B, consistent with typical Series B-to-next-stage progression. Peer-median analysis examined 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables including Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B), with observed range of $300M to $3.0B and median of $1.2B. The peer cohort suggests Defense Unicorns sits at the median valuation relative to its comp set.

Triangulating both methods yields a low estimate of $1.1B, median of $1.6B, and high estimate of $2.2B. The $1.1B–$2.2B band reflects material variation in peer valuation and stage-based progression assumptions. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to the peer set and the applicability of the 1.9x multiplier given the company's specific growth profile and market position within defense technology.
